# Hyperlink

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents a hyperlink annotation in a PDF document. Hyperlinks are clickable areas that navigate to a URI. This element implements IElement so it can be added like other elements.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Implements `IElement`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Hyperlink(string uri, string text)
new Hyperlink(string text)
```

## Properties

- [`Color`](#color): Gets or sets the text color for the link
- [`FontName`](#fontname): Gets or sets the font name for the link text
- [`FontSize`](#fontsize): Gets or sets the font size for the link text
- [`Margin`](#margin): Gets or sets the margin around the hyperlink
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): Always `Link`.
- [`TargetPageIndex`](#targetpageindex): Gets or sets the target 0-based page index (for internal links)
- [`Text`](#text): Gets the link text to display
- [`Underline`](#underline): Draws a line under the link text, in the link colour, placed as an underline decoration on text is.
- [`Uri`](#uri): Gets or sets the URI (URL) that this hyperlink points to
